title: Console realtime overlay shows issues from unrelated repos that share a project key
description: Repro: kbs init in two repos (both get the default key kanbus). Start kbsc in repo B. In repo A run kbs create. The issue appears on B's console board and in B's kbs list (Rust and Python), and is written to B/project/.overlay/issues/ for the overlay TTL (24h). One run put 329 foreign issues into a 6-issue board. Cause: realtime topic projects/{project_key}/events on the machine-wide broker socket, and the overlay accepts any message on that topic. Six of the maintainer's repos use the key kanbus. Expected: overlay only accepts events from the same repository identity, independent of project key.
